lines.text:
I only wore this because of the mission.
Don't get any weird ideas.
This is so awkward. I already said this doesn't suit me.
Ugh! I said stop calling me cute or I swear I'll smack you!

... S-so, what do you think? Do you like it?
I didn't wear it because of you, but... I just w-wanted to know what you think.

Well... I guess it's not so bad to dress up like this once in a while.
Especially since there's someone who seems to like it.

You know what? You're...
Um... you're... r-really handsome, Pal.

... Yeah, let me catch my breath for a sec.
Being around you looking like this... it's not good for my heart.

Pal, Pal! What're you up to? Are you busy?
... I-I'm not asking for your attention or anything. I'm just a little bored.
Uh... hold on. If Sugar and Frima see me like this...!

Do you want to try on a bunny girl outfit too, Pal?
Haha, sorry, just the thought of it cracks me up.
... Is it just me, or are there a lot of bunny girls everywhere?

Well? What do you think of bunny girl Milk?
H-hey! Eyes up here, jerk!
How do I look? Do I seem stronger?

I don't think it's the bunny girl outfit that made me stronger. 
What do you think it was, Pal?
As long as you're with me, Pal, I can keep getting stronger.
I feel like I'm always the one receiving from you. Thanks, Pal.
What do you want in return? Just say the word.
Hahaha. Don't tell me you like bunny girls that much you gave me a gift?

Do you like bunny girls, or do you like me? 
Although, I'm pretty sure I know the answer.
The more I get to know you, Pal, the more I like you.
I think I'm really fond of you, Pal.
Do you seriously want me to go out like this? Er, Pal...?

You've got some weird taste, Pal...
Whatever, it's no big deal. Let's go.

Are you seriously asking if I'm okay in these high heels?
What do you take me fo—eek?!
Just wipe that memory you have of me tripping.
Ever been punched by a bunny girl?!
Bunnies are actually carnivores!
This restrictive outfit isn't a problem at all!
Ow, my feet hurt...
This thing is tighter than I thought...
The outfit isn't ruined, is it?
Pal! I'm ready!
Hey. Q-quit looking at me like that!
Die! Die! Die!
Hahaha! Next!
I'm the killer bunny, punk!
One down!
Eek!
Ow!
Geez!
I-it's your fault for staring at me like that...
Hahaha! Fighting in this outfit is actually kind of fun!
